source_note: Chinese hot-topic candidates are collected from public trend pages; English wording is matched to supplied official English headlines when possible, otherwise suggested neutrally.

topics.chinese_topic: 三张照片 见证中美关系的刻度
topics.official_english: Three photos seen as a gauge of China-US relations
topics.why_hot: Sits at No. 1 on Baidu's realtime board, so it is the single most-viewed topic of the day; the framing suggests three widely circulated photos are being read as a snapshot of the current state of China-US ties. The specific photos and their context are not given in the topic text.
topics.share_angle: Explain why symbolic images (handshakes, seating, distance) become shorthand for diplomatic temperature, and walk through what to look for before drawing conclusions. Flag clearly that the underlying photos are unverified in the source text.

topics.chinese_topic: 房地产迎来史诗级大招
topics.official_english: China's property market braces for 'epic-scale' policy push
topics.why_hot: Housing policy affects household wealth, mortgage holders and local government finances, so any hint of a large-scale stimulus package dominates discussion. The topic text does not specify which measures are involved.
topics.share_angle: Set up a plain-English explainer on how Chinese property policy is usually delivered (rates, down payments, purchase limits, developer funding) and tell viewers what to verify once official documents appear rather than relying on the 'epic' label.

topics.chinese_topic: 重大利好！央行“四箭齐发”
topics.official_english: Central bank unveils 'four arrows' of policy support
topics.why_hot: Monetary policy moves are read as signals for stocks, mortgages and the yuan, and the 'four arrows' metaphor implies a coordinated package announced at once. The headline does not state which four tools were used.
topics.share_angle: Explain the standard toolkit the People's Bank of China uses (interest rates, reserve requirements, relending, liquidity operations) and how each one reaches ordinary people, while noting the topic text alone does not confirm details.

topics.chinese_topic: 中国已建成世界规模最大的教育体系
topics.official_english: China says it has built the world's largest education system
topics.why_hot: Education reaches nearly every family, and a claim about scale invites comparison on quality, funding and rural-urban gaps. The topic text gives the claim only, without supporting statistics.
topics.share_angle: Break down what 'largest' measures (enrolment, schools, teachers) versus what it does not (outcomes, spending per student), and compare with other large systems. Keep the framing descriptive rather than promotional.

topics.official_english: Teen athlete Chen Yujie pulls off a dramatic comeback win
topics.why_hot: A young athlete nicknamed 'kid sister' by Chinese fans winning from behind is a classic feel-good sports moment that travels easily across platforms. The topic text does not name the event or the opponent.
topics.share_angle: Use the clip as a gateway to talk about China's youth athletics pipeline and how viral nicknames shape an athlete's public image — and confirm the competition details before describing the race.

topics.chinese_topic: 老人报警丢4万民警找出23万
topics.official_english: Man reports losing 40,000 yuan; police find 230,000
topics.why_hot: A wholesome twist — police recover far more than the reported loss — makes it an easy, shareable local-news story with a positive tone. Details such as location and the reason for the discrepancy are not in the topic text.
topics.share_angle: Short human-interest segment: what happens procedurally when someone files a lost-property report, and why cash kept at home is a recurring theme among older residents. Avoid speculating about the family situation.

topics.official_english: China men's volleyball beats South Korea 3-2
topics.why_hot: A five-set win over a regional rival gives fans a clear result to rally around and drives highlight-sharing. The topic text does not say which tournament or stage the match belonged to.
topics.share_angle: Quick sports explainer on China's men's volleyball standing in Asia and why five-set wins matter for ranking points — confirm the competition name first.

topics.chinese_topic: 北京办抓“毛毛虫”大赛 2天抓7万条
topics.official_english: Beijing holds caterpillar-catching contest, 70,000 caught in two days
topics.why_hot: A quirky civic campaign that turns pest control into a public competition, with a striking number attached — the kind of story that spreads for its novelty. The species involved and the organisers are not specified in the topic text.
topics.share_angle: Explain the urban forestry logic behind pest-control campaigns, why an unusual headline number can be misleading (units, counting method, area covered), and how other cities handle similar outbreaks.
